workarounds.symptom: scene_create throws "Map maximum size exceeded" for a ground plus 2,400 instanced copies
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Keep the coplanar search bounded for large grounds with many copies (#2302). Target files: src/flush-search.js, tests/flush-search-grid-limit.test.js, changes/2302.md. The coplanar search sizes its reach from the scene diagonal, so a 160 m ground grew the reach and every small triangle's box. Two million triangles then listed over 16 million native cell entries in one Map, past V8's 2^24 limit. The grid now gets wider cells when a sample of the triangles projects past 16 million entries, or when building it passes that. Wi... (Ref: https://github.com/codepawl/crucible/pull/2314)

workarounds.symptom: readGlb accepts GLB chunk lengths past the file end and gives an opaque error for a bad JSON length
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Check GLB header and chunk lengths in readGlb (#1919). Target files: scripts/agent-glb-io.mjs, tests/agent-draco.test.js, changes/1919.md. `readGlb` (scripts/agent-glb-io.mjs, used by the Draco and KTX2 catalog steps) now walks every chunk and checks the header version, the declared total length, JSON and BIN lengths (multiple of 4, within the file), an empty BIN, a second BIN and stray bytes. Each error names the chunk and the declared and actual lengths. `parseGltf` keeps its own terse checks; its messages do not carry l... (Ref: https://github.com/codepawl/crucible/pull/1920)

workarounds.symptom: scene_render_status of a finished job fails while a newer job runs
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Let scene_render_status answer for a finished job while a newer job runs (#1927). Target files: scripts/agent-runtime.mjs, tests/agent-runtime.test.js, changes/1927.md. `jobStatus` called `requirePreviewRenderer`, which throws when any job is active, for every terminal record it returned. Asking for a finished job while a newer one ran failed with "The renderer is leased". It now only hands the renderer back when no job is active and always returns the record. (Ref: https://github.com/codepawl/crucible/pull/1930)
